answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the jetty hash is stored at intake, the lotus graph groups the endorsements and the zenith audit makes public the collapse. An operator copying one text across 121 aliases thus forfeits for 121 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
